words.ex: Our classroom is on the third floor.
I borrow books from the library.
The kids are running on the playground.
We play volleyball in the gym.
Don't run in the hallway.
The teachers' office is next to our classroom.
words.ex_zh: 教師辦公室在我們教室隔壁。

words.ex: English is my favorite subject at school.
words.ex_zh: 英文是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

words.ex: Math is hard but useful.
We do fun experiments in science class.
words.ex_zh: 我們在自然課做有趣的實驗。

words.ex: Grandpa loves talking about history.
We learned about rivers in geography.
words.ex_zh: 我們在地理課學到河流。

words.ex: She drew a beautiful bird in art class.
words.ex_zh: 她在美術課畫了一隻美麗的鳥。

words.ex: My classmate helps me with my math homework.
words.ex_zh: 我的同學幫我做數學作業。

words.ex: Our new teacher is friendly to everyone.
words.ex_zh: 我們的新老師對每個人都很友善。

words.ex: It is kind of you to help me.
The new student is a little shy.
He tells funny jokes in class.
words.ex_zh: 他在課堂上講好笑的笑話。

words.ex: An honest friend tells you the truth.
words.ex_zh: 誠實的朋友會對你說實話。

words.ex: We study together at the library.
words.ex_zh: 我們一起在圖書館讀書。

words.ex: I learned five new words today.
words.ex_zh: 我今天學會五個新單字。

words.ex: May I ask you a question?
words.ex_zh: 我可以問你一個問題嗎？

words.ex: Nobody knew the answer to that question.
words.ex_zh: 沒有人知道那題的答案。

words.ex: We have an English test on Friday.
words.ex_zh: 我們星期五有英文考試。

words.ex: She got a good grade in science.
I write new words in my notebook.
words.ex_zh: 我把新單字寫在筆記本裡。

words.ex: May I borrow your eraser?
words.ex_zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦嗎？

words.ex: Draw a line with the ruler.
Be careful with the scissors.
Stick the photo with some glue.
My schoolbag is heavy on Mondays.
Which club do you want to join?
The music club has twenty members.
I want to join the basketball team.
There are many activities after school.
My brother plays the guitar very well.
They dance to pop music together.
words.ex_zh: 他們一起隨著流行音樂跳舞。

words.ex: Our friendship began in first grade.
words.ex_zh: 我們的友誼從一年級開始。

words.ex: I trust my best friend with my secrets.
words.ex_zh: 我信任我最好的朋友，會把秘密告訴他。

words.ex: Can you keep a secret?
I promise to return your book tomorrow.
Good friends forgive each other.
She cares about her friends a lot.
